Title: Azure Monitor: Alerts on management events will be retired

Body.Content: Azure Monitor (formerly Azure Insights) offered a capability to create an alert for management events and generated notifications to a webhook URL or email addresses. This functionality has been transitioned to Activity Log alerts, and the resources assoicated with alerts on management events will be retired after October 1, 2017. For information on the change and how to prepare, see this article.
